metadata.description: Agent-agnostic skills by Adonis0123, installable as one Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: adonis-skills
plugins.description: Agent-agnostic skills by Adonis0123: review loops, workflow gates, MCP setup, commit and delivery helpers.

plugins.name: delete-guard
plugins.description: Hook plugin: denies shell commands that delete files an agent cannot get back (recursive rm, find -delete, git reset --hard) outside temp directories, and points the agent to the trash.

plugins.name: bash-prompt-guard
plugins.description: Hook plugin: denies Bash commands Claude Code's permission check cannot parse, so unattended runs do not stall on a prompt.

plugins.name: reply-language
plugins.description: Hook plugin: keeps user-facing replies in your language, taken from REPLY_LANGUAGE, Claude Code's language setting or the system language (first release: Chinese, zh).

plugins.name: completion-claim-check
plugins.description: Hook plugin: blocks the stop once when the agent says the work is done, the git working tree is dirty and the reply shows no verification evidence.
